takeaway: Tests cover node selection, text selection context, serializer/transform, and parsed context.
Tests assert DOM selection to editor selection and editor selection to DOM selection.
Undo tests restore selection and rebase selection through undo.
History tests keep undo-stack selection tied to the same editor.
Plain-text insertion is preferred for same HTML/plain payloads and multiline plain text is handled explicitly.
Generated node insertion updates selection format/style after insert.
Beforeinput can use targetRange and update selected text from DOM for tricky native sequences.
Native beforeinput historyUndo/historyRedo dispatch paths are explicit.
Same text/plain and text/html word-prediction payload is inserted as plain text to maintain formatting.
Input sequence fixtures assert expected HTML and selection after delete/undo/redo.
Inverse selection matrix is useful for anchor/focus drift classes.
Selection decoration hides while focused, editable, node-selected, or dragging.
Existing Slate v2 history contracts already assert selection restore/preserve cases.
Existing richtext tests cover structured heading copy/paste rows.
Paste-html suite already covers many external HTML/list/table/image/code import fixtures.
